title: Rescue a bad photo
drDigitalIntro:
This is your assessment for this unit. There are no step-by-step instructions this time — just a list of things to accomplish.

- At first nothing glows — you decide where to click. If you get really stuck, the yellow rings switch on and lead you to the finish.
- You can do the objectives in any order.
- Open the objectives list with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
- If you get stuck, the Hint button gives you a nudge — not the answer.

One photo in the library came out sideways and far too dark. Find it, fix it, and share it.

You are given one detail: the album must be called **Garden**. Everything else — which photo, which buttons, what order — is yours to work out.

playgroundTask.goal: You fixed and shared a photo unaided
playgroundTask.hint: Search rather than scrolling — the photo has a bird in it. Editing tools appear once a photo is selected. Albums are created from the sidebar.

steps.say: Find the bird photo by searching for it.
It is lying on its side. Turn it the right way up.
It is far too dark. Brighten it.
It looks flat. Give it more contrast.
Make a new album called Garden.
Put the photo in that album.
Send the fixed photo to Grandma.

drDigitalSuccess: You found it, straightened it, lit it, filed it, and sent it. That is the whole photo workflow, start to finish.
drDigitalHint: The magnifying glass searches by what is in the photo. Once a photo is open, the edit controls are along the side. Sharing asks you how first, then who.
